[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. **Abducted in Plain Sight** (2017) - A true crime documentary about a family whose daughter was kidnapped twice by a close family friend.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. **The Family I Had** (2020) - A documentary about a woman uncovering a dark family secret.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. **The Imposter** (2012) - A true story about a young Frenchman who impersonates a missing Texas boy.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. **The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley** (2019) - A documentary about the rise and fall of Theranos, founded by Elizabeth Holmes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. **The September Issue** (2009) - A behind-the-scenes look at the creation of the September issue of Vogue magazine.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. **Minding the Gap** (2018) - A coming-of-age documentary about three skateboarders from Illinois.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 11. **Three Identical Strangers** (2018) - A documentary about triplets separated at birth and reunited years later.
